question.worked_solution:
Here, we apply the addition, constant multiple, and power rules:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x} & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-4+2{x}^{7}-12{x}^{2}+{x}^{5/4}) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-4)+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(2{x}^{7})-\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(12{x}^{2})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{5/4}) \\  & =\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}(-4)+2\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{7})-12\cdot \frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{2})+\frac{\text{d}}{\text{d}x}({x}^{5/4}) \\  & =0+2\cdot 7{x}^{(7-1)}-12\cdot 2{x}^{(2-1)}+\frac{5}{4}\cdot {x}^{(\frac{5}{4}-1)} \\  & =14{x}^{6}-24x+\frac{5}{4}{x}^{1/4} \\  & =14{x}^{6}-24x+\frac{5\sqrt[4]{x}}{4}\end{aligned}
$$
